name: arte-modelo-dubois-2
description: Sistema de Facturación y Pedidos B2B — Arte Modelo Dubois 2.0

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=apps/api && npm run test --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test:coverage --workspace=apps/api && npm run test:coverage --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.db:local:setup: npm run db:sqlite:generate --workspace=apps/api && npm run db:sqlite:push --workspace=apps/api && npm run db:seed --workspace=apps/api
scripts.db:test:setup: npm run db:sqlite:generate --workspace=apps/api && npm run db:test:push --workspace=apps/api
